definitions.explanation: Raw substances used to make something.
Content or topics used for creating something.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}の{材料|ざいりょう}
{建築|けんちく}{材料|ざいりょう}
{材料|ざいりょう}を{集|あつ}める。
この{記事|きじ}を{書|か}くために、{様々|さまざま}な{材料|ざいりょう}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: I gathered various materials to write this article.

notes:
{材料|ざいりょう} refers to raw materials or ingredients.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {料理|りょうり}の{材料|ざいりょう} (cooking ingredients)
- {建築|けんちく}{材料|ざいりょう} (construction materials)
- {原|げん}{材料|ざいりょう} (raw materials)
- {話|はなし}の{材料|ざいりょう} (subject matter for discussion)

SIMILAR:
- {材料|ざいりょう}: ingredients, materials (general)
- {素材|そざい}: raw material, material (quality focus)
- {原料|げんりょう}: raw material (industrial)
